text: I think it's mainly about experiencing something different from your daily routine. When you travel, you try new food, hear other languages and see how other people live, which broadens your mind. It's also a great way to relax and make memories with family or friends. Personally, I find that a trip, even a short one, helps me feel refreshed and more motivated when I get back.

tips.en: The relative clause 'which broadens your mind' sums up the list.
tips.kk: «which broadens your mind» салалас бағыныңқысы тізімді қорытындылайды.
tips.ru: Относительное придаточное «which broadens your mind» обобщает перечисление.

tips.en: Personal experience makes the answer sincere.
tips.example: Personally, I find that a trip, even a short one, helps me feel refreshed

note.en: makes you more open to new ideas

questions.followUp: Do you think travel is better than staying at home?
questions.question: Why do people enjoy travelling to other countries?

text: The main advantage is convenience: flights, hotels and activities are all arranged, so there's very little stress. They're also often cheaper than booking everything separately. The downside is that you have less freedom, and you tend to visit the same crowded tourist spots. I'd say they suit families or first-time travellers, whereas independent travellers would probably find them too restrictive.

tips.en: 'The downside is that' moves clearly to the drawbacks.
tips.kk: «The downside is that» кемшіліктерге анық өтеді.
tips.ru: «The downside is that» чётко переходит к минусам.
tips.example: The downside is that you have less freedom
whereas independent travellers would probably find them too restrictive

note.en: people travelling for the first time

questions.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of package holidays?

text: Mostly negatively, I'm afraid. Millions of flights produce huge amounts of carbon emissions, and popular destinations often suffer from litter and damaged nature. For example, some beaches have had to close temporarily because there were simply too many visitors. That said, tourism can also fund conservation projects. If tourists chose eco-friendly hotels and travelled in smaller numbers, the impact could be reduced considerably.

tips.en: 'Mostly... I'm afraid' delivers an unwelcome truth gently.
tips.kk: «Mostly... I'm afraid» жағымсыз шындықты жұмсақ жеткізеді.
tips.ru: «Mostly... I'm afraid» мягко подаёт неприятную правду.

tips.en: A second conditional with a passive shows advanced grammar.
tips.kk: Пассивті екінші типті шартты сөйлем жоғары грамматиканы көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Условное второго типа с пассивом показывает продвинутую грамматику.
tips.example: If tourists chose eco-friendly hotels and travelled in smaller numbers, the impact could be reduced considerably

note.en: a polite way to say something unwelcome

questions.followUp: What can tourists do about it?
questions.question: How has the growth of tourism affected the environment?

text: My guess is more, at least in the short term, since flights are getting cheaper and remote work lets people stay abroad for months. In the long run, though, rising fuel costs and stricter environmental rules might discourage frequent flying. Virtual reality tours could also become a substitute for some trips, though I doubt they'll ever replace the real thing. So I'd expect people to travel less often but stay longer.

tips.en: 'My guess is' suits predictions about the future.
tips.ru: «My guess is» подходит для прогнозов о будущем.

tips.en: Comparing short and long term organises the answer.
tips.kk: Қысқа және ұзақ мерзімді салыстыру жауапты құрылымдайды.
tips.ru: Сравнение краткосрочной и долгосрочной перспективы организует ответ.
tips.example: In the long run, though, rising fuel costs and stricter environmental rules might discourage frequent flying

questions.question: Do you think people will travel more or less in the future?
